info.name: Bridge DLL API
info.description: REST API for the copy trading bridge (MetaTrader 4/5). The bridge runs locally when an EA is attached; default port is 40000. All endpoints are documented here; there is no public Swagger/OpenAPI endpoint.

request.description: Creates a new order. Body is the order payload (symbol, type, side, volume, price, sl, tp). For slave accounts the bridge may convert symbol/volume according to config. Returns 200 with success/error, or 202 if MT did not ack in time.
Modifies an existing order (SL, TP, price). Body must include ticket and the fields to change.
Cancels an order. Body must include ticket.
Configures the account as master (source for copy trading). master_tcp_url is ignored for masters. Other accounts connect to this account's TCP URL to receive trading events.

body.raw:
{
  "role": "slave",
  "master_tcp_url": "tcp://localhost:50000/87654321",
  "lot_type": "multiplier",
  "lot_multiplier": 1.0,
  "fixed_lot": null,
  "reverse_trading": false,
  "prefix": { "enabled": false, "value": null, "action": "add" },
  "suffix": { "enabled": false, "value": null, "action": "add" },
  "symbol_translations": []
}

request.description: Configures the account as slave (follower). master_tcp_url can be null if no master is connected yet. Accepts snake_case (role, master_tcp_url, lot_type, lot_multiplier, fixed_lot, reverse_trading, prefix, suffix, symbol_translations) or camelCase (masterTcpUrl, lotType, lotMultiplier, fixedLot, reverseTrading). lot_type: 'fixed' or 'multiplier'. prefix/suffix: { enabled, value, action: 'add'|'remove' }. symbol_translations: ["SOURCE:TARGET", ...]. If account has a server, body must include server and it must match.
Deletes the account configuration. Send empty body or body with role null.

query.description: true to enable TCP, false to disable

request.description: Turns TCP connection on or off without changing account config. Same auth (x-api-key, x-api-secret) and account_id must match the bridge account. When disabled: master stops emitting events and stops TCP server; slave disconnects from master. When enabled: master starts TCP server and emits; slave connects to master_tcp_url if configured. Does not change heartbeat response format.
